profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Databricks
profile.summary:
I work on container and node infrastructure for compute at Databricks.

Previously, I've worked on:

* Intra-network inventory transfers at Shopify Logistics
* Kubernetes artifact bundle validation and ephemeral test environment provisioning at Salesforce
* Market anomaly detection as one of the first engineering hires at Kalshi

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
OS & Container Platform

Notable projects include:

Lazy container loading for untrusted UDFs

Cross-storage-account replication for OCI artifacts

Container checkpoint and restore (https://www.databricks.com/blog/booting-databricks-vms-7x-faster-serverless-compute)

Node health checks for GPU workloads

Serverless OS release infrastructure/release stability

projects.title: SoleScrape
projects.description: A Node.js based web scraper that gathers data about hyped-up shoes from a friendly neighborhood apparel site. Used Puppeteer to capture JavaScript-rendered content and Cheerio to traverse markup, all contained on an Express.js server. Also incorporated a simple frontend with React.

projects.title: Clippr
projects.description: A desktop application that monitors system clipboard history and displays it for reference and easy retrieval of previously copied items. Built with the Electron framework using Node.js and Sass. Earned 1st Place at the 2019 Washington Technology Student Association state conference and was a finalist at the 2019 Technology Student Association national conference.
